title: 선택이란
sp: K-Pop Ballad. Violin and piano perform a final unison scale ending on a sharp staccato D major chord. The rhythm section consists of a double bass playing on-beat roots and fifths, and a drum kit utilizing a crisp snare and hi-hat for a driving 2/4 polka-style beat. A warm electric bass enters on the first beat of the verse, following the root notes of the guitar progression. drums stop abruptly. baritone male vocals enter. A lush string section provides legato accompaniment, with cellos and violins entering in the second phrase. The track features a sudden tempo drop and atmospheric transition before the final chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[filtered acoustic piano enters with a four-bar loop]
[piano melody fills]

[Verse 1]
목에 넘어가는 순간
과거가 신체가 된다
맛이란 무엇인가
기억의 물질화
혀가 기억하는 시절의 온도

[Chorus]
선택이란 무엇인가
걸어온 길 위의 나는
여전히 떨리는 손을 가졌는가
클릭한다
눈을 감는다
버려진 우주에게
작별을 고하리라

[Interlude]
[staccato strings, piano melody]
[piano block chords, staccato strings]

[Verse 2]
더 이상 볼 수 없는 나를
왜 지켜야 하는지 몰라
상처만 남길 사랑보다
떠나는 게 낫지 않을까

[Chorus]
선택이란 무엇인가
걸어온 길 위의 나는
여전히 떨리는 손을 가졌는가
클릭한다
눈을 감는다
버려진 우주에게
작별을 고하리라

[Bridge]
그 이후는 서서히 뭉개져가고
우리는 또 문질러야 한다
이 반복이 삶이라면
그건 슬프지만 아름다운 일이야

[Outro]
[strings fade to pianissimo, final piano chord]
[piano filter closes further, reducing high-end clarity]
song_form_type: intro → verse → chorus → interlude → verse → chorus → bridge → outro

title: 하나
sp: K-Indie Pop with a laid-back, jazzy R&B influence. The structure is characterized by call-and-response between brass and woodwinds, building to a full orchestral crescendo with sustained brass chords and rapid percussion flourishes. fingerpicked acoustic guitar, solo cello melody. The arrangement centers on a solo cello playing a melodic counterpoint and a fingerpicked acoustic guitar. syncopated snare rolls. The female vocals are delivered in a soft, breathy, and intimate style with minimal processing, emphasizing natural vibrato and clear diction. full band, power chords. The arrangement maintains a consistent 4/4 time signature at 120 BPM in the key of C Major.

사랑이 식은 건지 형태가 바뀐 건지 헷갈렸어
